tagline: A little more peace of mind.
intro: Stay connected to the people you love. Let Catchy help you notice suspicious requests.
warning: ഈ വിളിക്കുന്നയാൾക്ക് രഹസ്യ കോഡ് പറയരുത്, പണം അയക്കരുത്, ആപ്പ് ഇൻസ്റ്റാൾ ചെയ്യരുത്. കോൾ അവസാനിപ്പിച്ച് സ്വതന്ത്രമായി പരിശോധിക്കുക.
noContact: Add an accepted trusted contact first.
speaker: Speakerphone
consentText: Get permission from everyone involved. Catchy never stores raw audio. Microphone speech recognition may send audio to your browser vendor. Same-phone calls can block microphone access; a second device may be needed.
consentCheck: I understand and have permission to continue.
beta: Beta · partial translation · not field validated
permissionDenied: Microphone permission was denied. Allow access in browser settings, or use typed input.
offline: You are offline. Live protection is unavailable.
serverError: The server is unreachable. Protection has stopped.
speechError: Speech recognition stopped. Try again or use typed input.
unsupported: Speech recognition is unavailable here. Choose typed input or a demo.
background: Protection paused because this screen is no longer visible. Keep Catchy open while listening.
silence: No speech has been received. Check the microphone and whether another call is using it.
name: Name
authNeeded: Sign in to save sessions and manage trusted contacts.
guestNotice: Guest analysis is temporary. No history is saved.
emptyHistory: Your saved sessions will appear here.
inviteNotice: The invited person must sign in with their own email and accept. Creating a link does not send a message.
retentionHelp: Off by default. Redaction may miss personal details. Never enter actual passwords or secret codes.
analyticsHelp: Only alert shown, dismissed and contact-called events. No account identifier or conversation content.
deleteAll: Delete all my data and account
deleteAllConfirm: Permanently delete your account, contacts and sessions? This cannot be undone.
asrNotice: Browser recognition may use the browser vendor’s servers. Self-hosted recognition requires a configured service.
installHelp: Use your browser menu → Add to Home screen. HTTPS is required outside localhost.
supportNote: A low-risk result does not prove the caller is genuine.
phoneNote: Keep this screen open. Catchy cannot intercept or end normal phone calls.
providerUnavailable: Message service is not configured. No alert was sent.
alertSent: Alert delivered to the provider. Delivery to the recipient is not guaranteed.
cooldown: An alert was already requested recently.
inviteInvalid: This invitation is invalid, expired or for a different account.
noVoice: No matching voice is installed. Read the warning on screen.
synthetic: Synthetic development cases, not field accuracy.
trustedHelp: Accepted contacts choose whether to receive metadata alerts. No transcript or audio is shared.
humanReview: Translations and speech support require device and native-speaker review.
caption: YOUR PERSONAL SAFETY COMPANION
footer: Designed for confidence. Built with care.
step1Text: Choose microphone, a typed message, or a safe simulation.
step2Text: Catchy looks for risky requests across the conversation.
step3Text: Follow clear guidance and contact someone you trust.
alertOptIn: Offer an alert to accepted contacts when danger is detected
error: Unable to complete the request. Please try again.
signinPrivacy: Your account stores only the information you choose to keep.
accountLocal: Email and password sign-in. Email delivery must be configured for verification.
deleteWarning: This action permanently removes your account.
verificationSent: If configured, a verification code has been sent.
verificationNeeded: Verify your email to accept invitations.
asrUnavailable: Self-hosted speech is not configured. Choose browser recognition or typed input.
testCallHelp: Use a local simulation or microphone on an authorized test call. Network VoIP requires a configured partner service.
modelFallback: Contextual AI is unavailable. Rules-only protection is active.
deliveryUncertain: Delivery is uncertain. Check with your trusted person before trying again.
englishFallback: This page is currently available in English for your selected language.
englishDemo: This simulation uses English. Typed analysis is available in your selected language.
smokeDataset: Lexicon-derived smoke tests. These are not independent accuracy measurements.
